description: This file contains unit tests for the FrequentEdgeCounter class used in activation repartitioning within Orleans. It defines test cases for adding edges, updating counters, capacity management, and removal of edges, along with some interface definitions related to grain communication patterns.

classes.name: FrequentEdgeCounterTests
classes.description: Unit test class for testing the behavior of the FrequentEdgeCounter class in activation repartitioning scenarios.

methods.name: Add_ShouldIncrementCounter_WhenEdgeIsAdded
methods.description: Tests that adding an edge increments its counter in the FrequentEdgeCounter.

methods.name: Add_ShouldUpdateExistingCounter_WhenSameEdgeIsAddedAgain
methods.description: Tests that adding the same edge again updates its counter rather than creating a new one.

methods.name: Add_ShouldRemoveMinCounter_WhenCapacityIsReached
methods.description: Tests that when capacity is exceeded, the counter with the minimum count is removed.

methods.name: Remove_ShouldRemoveCounter_WhenEdgeIsRemoved
methods.description: Tests that removing an edge deletes its counter from the FrequentEdgeCounter.
